ctx.x: eventually and the band did quite well yes i think most people agree that there's a crane river band and that's the most exciting in british jazz um what about the the tunes then um before you'd heard any new orleans jazz in the flesh uh where did you draw your tunes from was it still mostly from records

mostly from records but then i out there and a lot of the bun johnson records especially i realized that it was a case of uh often there was plenty of tunes i never heard bunk played but if you absolved the style enough then you could uh adapt material whether you you didn't have to copy it off a record whether you'd heard the new orleans band play the tune or not you could still play them uh in in the uh style
